items.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: I used to play in this big band and there was this kid there at the time, a trumpet player named Gregg Glassman.

ctx.x: Um hum. Like world music and everything.

Yeah. Which Karl Berger started at the Creative Music Studio. It’s improvised music, and it’s not improvised music. It’s a combination, a re-combination of things. So yeah, I think there are innovators all the time. There may be innovators that just remind you that music is not high — that bring you back to your heart for instance. There can be one guy out there who just plays — you hear something on — I used to play in this big band and there was this kid there at the time, a trumpet player named Gregg Glassman.…
Well you and I have been able to be in the presence of some very classy people.
